title: Optative
summary: OP'TATIVE, adjective [Latin optativus, from opto, to desire or wish.] Expressing desire or wish. The optative mode, in grammar, is that form of the verb in which wish or desire is expressed. OP'TATIVE

inlines.v: OP'TATIVE, adjective [Latin optativus, from opto, to desire or wish.] Expressing desire or wish. The optative mode, in grammar, is that form of the verb in which wish or desire is expressed. OP'TATIVE, noun Something to be desired. [Little used.]
